# Rule 6 - No Explicit/Shock Content
This is a 16+ server, so there are minors here. While you don't have to keep it family-friendly, ERP (Erotic Roleplay) is strictly prohibited. Should another player say something that genuinely offends you, [italic]please[/italic] let the admins know via admin help (F1) so that they can look into this further.
In-character relationships are acceptable, but any physicality should be limited to what would be acceptable in a PG-13 movie or T-rated video game. If you are ever unsure about the specifics of this precedent, you should ask in admin help for clearance.
## Precedents
- Referencing or replicating major traumatic real-life historical events [italic]for the purposes of shocking or offending someone either in-character or out-of-character[/italic]. - The occasional sex joke or innuendo [bolditalic]MAY[/bolditalic] be fine in-context; however, don't make a habit out of it. Making people uncomfortable is unacceptable. - No shock content, whether sexual or gory in nature. - Language, as long as it is [textlink="not bigotry" link="RuleBigotry"], is fine. Feel free to cuss like a sailor!
